purpose: This table provides a cleaned registry of aircraft referenced by flight records, keyed by tail number, feeding downstream flight and aircraft analytics.
usage: Join on tailnum to enrich flight records with aircraft characteristics such as manufacturer, model, engine type, and seat capacity; consumers should expect null values for year (2.1% missing) and especially speed (99.3% missing) and handle them explicitly rather than assuming presence.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the near-total absence of speed data (null_rate 0.993076) or the smaller gap in year (null_rate 0.021072); both columns remain nullable rather than imputed. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication logic was applied.
